item.description: Neil Parker has spent nearly three decades tracking the yen, through financial crises and sharp currency swings. Now, the top dollar-yen forecaster in Bloomberg’s latest rankings sees the Japanese currency rallying toward 147 per dollar next year as Japan’s interest-rate gap with the US narrows.

item.title: Broadcom shares pop over 9%, on track for biggest one-day surge in a year. What's driving the rebound?
item.description: Broadcom shares rose 9.5% to $321 after it announced Kubernetes initiatives at KubeCon North America 2026, including its VM API project entering the CNCF Sandbox, a new workload standards role, and more than 20 validated VMware VKS partner solutions.

item.title: AMD stock rallies 12% as Google Cloud taps its EPYC processors for next-generation AI infrastructure
item.description: AMD shares rose 12.5% after the company announced its fifth-generation EPYC processors will power Google Cloud TPU 8tx systems. The partnership combines AMD CPUs and security technology with Google’s AI accelerators to support confidential AI workloads, protecting sensitive data as it is processed.

item.title: Wall Street bounces back from AI sell-off, Nasdaq rallies over 3%, but Nvidia plunges 9% on Jensen Huang controversy
item.description: US stocks rebounded Monday after their worst weekly performance in nearly two years, with the Dow, S&amp;P 500 and Nasdaq rising as lower oil prices and bargain-buying lifted sentiment. Investors turned their attention to upcoming inflation data and earnings from AI-related companies.

item.title: Eternal shares rebound over 70% from March lows, emerge as top Nifty 50 recovery stock; what drove the rally?
item.description: Eternal shares have rebounded 71% from their March low, making the company a standout Nifty recovery story as Swiggy struggles. Growth is supported by Blinkit’s expanding store network, rising order value and six consecutive quarters of improving margins.

item.title: Gold vs silver vs copper vs platinum: Which metal could deliver the biggest returns in Samvat 2083?
item.description: Silver has the strongest potential among the four metals for Samvat 2083 after a steep correction, though its volatility poses significant risk. Gold may suit investors seeking resilience, thanks to central bank buying and ETF holdings.

item.title: Chemplast Sanmar shares jump over 11% in biggest single-day gain in 10 months as Q2 rally gathers pace
item.description: Chemplast Sanmar shares jumped 11.44% to ₹237 after stronger-than-expected Q2 FY27 results. Revenue rose 28% year on year to ₹1,323 crore, EBITDA reached ₹111 crore, and net loss narrowed to ₹5 crore.

item.title: KPI Green Energy shares jump 9% on massive volume spike ahead of Q2 results; what's driving the rally?
item.description: KPI Green Energy shares rose 9% to ₹331 on Monday as trading volume surged to 64.35 times the weekly average, despite no immediate fundamental trigger. The rally came ahead of quarterly results and followed new project capacity energisations, though the stock remains down 34%.

item.title: Top 3 stocks to buy this week: Union Bank, Ather Energy, Laurus Labs by market expert; check stop-loss, target price
item.description: Indian benchmarks rose to their highest levels in over eight months, with the Nifty gaining 0.23% and Sensex 0.13%, as crude prices eased. Markets close Tuesday for Diwali. Analyst Chandan Taparia recommended Union Bank of India, Ather Energy and Laurus Labs, citing bullish technical signals.

item.title: 700% return in 5 years: KP Energy share price rallies 20% to hit upper circuit ahead of Q2 results 2026- Check details
item.description: KP Energy shares surged 19.99% to ₹204.95 on Monday, hitting the upper circuit as trading volume rose more than tenfold ahead of the company’s Q2 FY27 results. Its board is scheduled to review the results on November 13.

item.description: Nvidia shares fell 6% in pre-market trading after the company’s board launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair with a woman suspected by US authorities of spying for China.&nbsp;

item.title: Top PSU stock to buy: Brokerage sees 50% upside! Gujarat Energy shares gain 2% as profit surges 26% - Check target price
item.description: Gujarat Energy shares rose nearly 2% after the company reported a 21.9% year-on-year increase in second-quarter net profit to ₹639.27 crore. Motilal Oswal maintained its Buy rating and ₹325 target price, citing strong gas distribution growth and other business strengths.

item.title: Winter is coming! Voltas delivers strong Q2 results. Should you buy the Tata Group AC maker as cold winds rise?
item.description: Voltas shares rose 2.5% after Q2 FY27 net profit increased 51.4% year on year to ₹47.71 crore and revenue grew 15.3% to ₹2,706.57 crore. Room air conditioners led growth, while project revenue fell. Brokerages differed on the stock, with target prices ranging from ₹1,160 to ₹1,500.

item.title: ₹13 to ₹82: This multibagger small-cap stock turns ₹1 lakh into 6.5 lakh in just 10 months. Do you own it?
item.description: Rajvi Logitrade shares have surged 566% in 2026, rising from ₹13 to ₹83, while a ₹1 lakh investment at the start of the year would be worth about ₹6.5 lakh. The logistics company has a market capitalisation of ₹52 crore, but thin trading volumes may limit liquidity.

item.description: The plan was significant as it offered a relatively low-cost entry point for users with a daily data limit of 1GB. After scrapping the plan on 12 August, Airtel’s cheapest entry-level plan was the ₹349 plan, offering 1.5GB of data per day.

item.description: European power prices surged above €600 a megawatt-hour for peak evening periods on Monday due to a collapse in wind generation, showing how tight electricity markets can become when renewable output is weak.

item.title: Alembic shares: Big 15% jump after Q2 results, gains 27% in two weeks: Can the rally continue? What experts say
item.description: Alembic shares surged more than 15% after its Q2 FY27 results. Net profit fell 11.2% year on year to ₹67.57 crore, while revenue dropped 45.9% to ₹30.25 crore. Analysts cited strong buying interest but said a sustained move above key resistance levels is needed to confirm further gains.
